checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: A water bottle is the main subject and is fully visible.
The bottle has a matte black finish rather than a glossy or metallic finish.
must.why: Bottle is brushed silver stainless steel, not matte black.

must.item: The bottle stands on a visibly veined marble surface.
must.why: Plain light gray studio surface, no marble.

must.item: Lighting is soft, with gentle shadows rather than harsh glare.
must.why: Soft diffuse light with a gentle shadow, though some metallic highlights.

faults.what: Bottle is silver metallic, not matte black
No marble surface; plain gray background

summary: A clean, well-lit brushed stainless steel bottle on gray came out, but it is not matte black and has no veined marble surface.
